area: Data Studio uploads (found while re-checking pass 4 PB-265, RC-43)
title: A 30 to 40 byte cut-off .xlsx makes SheetJS XLSX.read run without returning, and uploads are parsed on the server's own thread, so one small upload can stall the whole server
where: chennai-grievance-portal-main/src/lib/studio/parse.ts:275 (excelAll: XLSX.read), reached from src/app/api/collector/studio/route.ts:77 ingest -> src/lib/studio/pipeline.ts:123 parseFileAsync -> parseAll; also src/lib/studio/connect/index.ts:72 for fetched links
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main; timeout 25 node C:/Users/arjun/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/86ab7bcd7f3fc2bb/20a1546c-175e-487f-85fd-dbc6ea4005f9/scratchpad/xlsx-trunc.cjs 40 (the first 40 bytes of a 166-byte zip, read with excelAll's options). Probe: npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/pass4-open/studio-parse.test.ts -t "cut off after 40 bytes" (runs the same XLSX.read in a worker thread: 'no answer after 10 s'). Calling parseAll directly in the test never finished (killed by timeout 70).
evidence: n=30 and n=40 bytes: no return in 25 s (exit 124), and n=40 again: no return in 90 s; n=22: threw after 1.9 s; n=60: threw after 3 ms. The vitest worker on the same case used 200 s of CPU before it was killed. Deliberately not sent to the shared server on 3106 (it would stall it for every hunter).
cause: isZip() looks only at the PK header, so a cut-off zip named .xlsx goes to XLSX.read (xlsx 0.20.3), which does not return on the damaged archive; the parser runs synchronously inside the route, with no worker or time limit.
